verdict.rationale: Clerk's changelog describes a standards-based OAuth grant that lets CLIs and other input-constrained devices have a user approve access from a browser-capable device without entering credentials on the original device. That is the device authorization flow, and it sits on top of Clerk's documented OAuth implementation with scoped access. missing for 10: dedicated in-depth docs for the device grant (endpoints, polling, token lifetimes), explicit coverage of headless agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
